description: Agentic chat: a deliberately broad, corpus-wide report so the searchers pile a large shared context on the report writer, which then has to window it by token budget (createAgentTemplateParams splitByBudget -> TokensBudgetFluxCoordinator). This is a non-regression smoke: a report writer that cannot window a shared context bigger than one LLM window stops producing an answer - before the windowing fix an oversized single contribution looped instead of returning, so the run never completed. Which route the controller picks stays soft, as everywhere else in this suite. Since the CI corpus was cut to five short apocrypha (about 52k tokens) to save vendor tokens, the shared context may no longer exceed one LLM window, so this request may not reach the windowing path any more: it remains a corpus-wide chat check.
